subject: Risk & Compliance
title: Identity Theft at Scale
description: A 60-second lesson on Identity Theft at Scale.

hook.text: Someone opens credit cards, takes loans, and rents apartments in your name. You find out months later.

buildup.text: Identity theft affects over 15 million Americans annually. Stolen data fuels a massive underground economy.

discovery.text: Data breaches provide the raw material. A full identity sells for as little as $10 on the dark web.

twist.text: Victims spend an average of 200 hours resolving identity theft. Many face years of damaged credit.

climax.text: Identity theft is industrial-scale crime powered by data breaches and weak verification systems.

punchline.text: Your identity for $10. 200 hours to fix. That's the deal.

quiz.question: How much does a stolen identity sell for on the dark web?
